title: Astrunium
description: Astrunium is a data pack that provides an enhanced vanilla experience through boss loot, new uses for items, and over 40 new enchantments!
body:
This data pack is designed to provide an enhanced vanilla experience and used on its own or with some other very small data packs or any type of mod. The primary additions are **enchantments** and **boss loot**.

Check out all the features [here](https://mcglint.com/astrunium)
